solutionSql:
(SELECT status FROM shipments EXCEPT SELECT status FROM shipment_events)
UNION
(SELECT status FROM shipment_events EXCEPT SELECT status FROM shipments)
ORDER BY status;

ambiguities.readingChosen: Ascending ORDER BY status with the default collation.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Case-insensitive or locale-specific ordering. Every status on the sample is lowercase, so the output is the same.

notes: Symmetric difference of the two status sets: six values on the sample.
